task_spec.text: Find the messages about the GPU cluster memory/capacity investigation that were posted in a channel where one of our workspace admins is a member, and report what those messages say.

access_plan: Use user_teams to find users with an admin role in Test Workspace (Robert Walsh, Morgan Freeman), then channel_members to find which channels those admins belong to (general, random, engineering for Walsh; none for Freeman). Use conversations.history/search.messages on those channels to look for GPU cluster memory/capacity content and confirm only login/auth topics remain in engineering. Separately confirm via channel_members and conversations.history that #core-infra, which holds both the OOM/CUDA-limit thread and the relocated circuit-tracer VRAM/sharding thread, has no admin-role member, establishing that no channel satisfies both conditions and the result set is absent.
